purpose: roll back an orders-api deploy that is crash looping
when_to_use: when the OrdersApiCrashLooping alert fires, or when orders-api pods are in CrashLoopBackOff after a deploy
prerequisites: kubectl access to the shop namespace
The revision number of the last good deploy, from the deploy channel

steps.instruction: Confirm the pods are crash looping.
steps.expect: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff with a rising restart count.
An error printed just before exit, for example "config error: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL is not set".

steps.instruction: Compare the config with the last good revision.
steps.expect: The variable named in the error is missing or changed in the new revision.

steps.instruction: Roll back to the last good revision.
steps.expect: The rollout finishes and pods stay running.

rollback.instruction: Re-apply the new revision only after its config is fixed.

escalation: page the orders team lead if orders are still failing 10 minutes after step 4
